## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes  
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] `npm run test` passes (set `TEST_DATABASE_URL` for integration tests)
- [ ] New code follows RBAC conventions (permissions defined, mapped, enforced, UI-gated)
- [ ] New endpoints are documented in `lib/openapi.json`
- [ ] Docs updated if public-facing behaviour changed
